notes: Two <trkseg> elements inside one <trk>, laid out the way buildFinalPlannedGpx emits legs: segment 2 opens on segment 1's closing coordinate. This fixture exists to prove no per-segment metrics-anchor reset was introduced when the i = 0 loop bound was fixed -- the shared GpxMetricsComputation instance must carry its distance anchor across the segment boundary, measuring through it rather than restarting. Pre-fix value was 333.585 (each segment's own first point dropped, losing one real hop's worth of distance per segment).
